correctness.rationale: Soft thresholding has independently realizable zero-one Haar derivative masks; the one-jump BV unit-ball reduction is exact. An endpoint sign bound on selected Haar details removes absolute values in each dyadic child interface and produces the nine-state integer recursion with no numerical approximation. The lower construction uses disjoint gradient supports at 8-separated scales and a uniform geometric-series estimate; each wavelet contributes at most two units of variation. The proof is all-depth; the separate exact-rational and integer checker corroborated depths 1–14 and direct mask enumeration through depth 7. The theorem does not assert a closed-form sequence beyond its exact recursion.

originality.rationale: The closest primary works treat statistical performance of wavelet shrinkage, general BV non-unconditionality, weak-type Haar Lp estimates and a different TV-minimizing reconstruction method. Those do not state or directly imply the exact all-depth nine-state path-BV perturbation formula and its quantitative logarithmic instability bound. The finite signed L-infinity result is not the same norm or zero-one mask family. Priority is provisional because some plausible full texts are inaccessible and an unindexed equivalent cannot be excluded.

value.rationale: The precise all-depth integer recurrence replaces a 2^(N-1) active-set search with O(N) operations for a canonical denoising map; independently of that computational gain, it demonstrates a quantitatively growing sharp two-input path-variation instability of order log N despite Euclidean nonexpansivity. This is naturally motivated by classical BV non-unconditionality and the risk of oversensitivity to jump perturbations, not by arbitrary parameter tuning. The finite coefficients and explicit construction are mathematically informative in their own right.
